apps.name: Relay
apps.subtitle: Hyper-private E2EE messaging
apps.localizedDescription: End-to-end encrypted messaging and voice/video for a closed circle of friends. All content is encrypted client-side; the server is zero-knowledge.

privacy.NSLocalNetworkUsageDescription: Used for WebRTC peer discovery via STUN.
privacy.NSUserNotificationsUsageDescription: Used to notify you when new messages arrive while the app is in the background.
